messages:
Sonia: quick follow-up from the kv-cache postmortem. need owners/timelines for the tests & evals we promised. low-noise items below.

Sonia: action sketch: 
- regression CI reproducer + gate (owner: Liam)
- focused prompt-set for long-tail sequences (owner: Ava)
- Dedicated-like load profile + gradeload run (owner: ProductOps)
- tabletop + chaos drill runbook (owner: Sonia)
- alerting rule + dashboard (owner: SRE, assignable)

Liam: i can do the repro->pytest conversion and wire it into crit-regressions CI. i have a local script that reproduces eviction under seq_len 2048. target: PR by 2026-03-22.

Ava: will assemble prompt-set. plan: 25 synthetic tails + 15 anonymized customer prompts that exercised the eviction. will add to evals/regress/kv_tail_set and a small harness to compare float vs q8. ETA 2026-03-18.

ProductOps: for load test, request a 6-node dev Dedicated pool for a 2hr run. proposed params:
```
profile: mixed_burst
virtual_users: 60
qps_peak: 140
batch_range: 1..12
seq_len_p95: 2048
duration: 2h
```
we'll collect p50/p95/p99 latency, cache eviction counters, and sampler traces. schedule depends on infra provisioning.

Sonia: acceptance criteria (short):
- CI: failing test if eviction rate increases >10% or p95 latency >2x baseline
- prompt-set: at least 10 real anon prompts, 30 synthetic edge cases
- load test: must hit autoscaler and compaction paths and produce dashboard tiles
- drill: documented runbook + rollback steps

Liam: CI command i'll add to the pipeline:
```
pytest tests/regress/test_kv_tail.py::test_kv_eviction --runslow --junitxml=artifacts/kv_tail.xml
```
will include reproducer snippet and telem tags.

Ava: eval harness will flag quality regression >5% (task-specific metric) and produce a small HTML diff report. will PR by 3/18.

ProductOps: created infra ticket INFRA-4977 for provisioning. ETA 2026-03-23. will attach sampling buckets.

DevOps-bot: Task INFRA-4977 created by ProductOps. Link: https://redwood.internal/tasks/INFRA-4977

Sonia: i'll own the chaos drill coordination. propose two drills: (1) autoscaler flapping, (2) compaction + mixed load. each drill: 60m, checklist, post-run notes. tentatively 3/27 and 3/29.

ProductOps: ack, will reserve Dedicated dev pool windows pending INFRA-4977 completion.

Liam: ack. will open the regression PR and tag this thread.

Ava: ack. i'll drop the prompt-set link here when ready.

Sonia: thanks all. please update task tracker with progress. ping me if blocked. :rocket:
